hero.subtitle: Touch. Press. Feel. Take action.PitsBoard combines tactile controls, visual overlays, and application-specific profiles.A new way to interact with software.

whatsPitsboard.title: Why PitsBoard
whatsPitsboard.subtitle: Most software is designed around keyboards, mice, and touchscreens.
whatsPitsboard.desc1: PitsBoard explores what happens when physical controls, adaptive interfaces, and application-specific workflows become part of the same system.
whatsPitsboard.desc2: An experimental platform for rethinking digital interaction.A physical layer for digital tools.

howPitsboardWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howPitsboardWorks.subtitle: Hardware, Overlay, and Studio work together to create a seamless physical-digital workflow.
howPitsboardWorks.hwDesc: Touch,press and swipe on the physical board.
howPitsboardWorks.overlayDesc: Visual contrals appear on screen where you are looking.
howPitsboardWorks.studioDesc: Create and customize your own interactions and layouts.

ecosystem.title: HOW IT CONNECTS
ecosystem.subtitle: Connect physical interactions to apps, tools, and AI.
ecosystem.block1Desc: Modular physical input platform capturing high-precision dial, fader, and mechanical key events.
ecosystem.block2Desc: Intermediary translation layer transforming tactile physical triggers into actions.
ecosystem.block3Desc: End-point destinations executing automation, shortcuts, local system commands, or AI triggers.

useCases.title: WORKFLOW EXAMPLES
useCases.subtitle: Examples of how PitsBoard can adapt to different workflows.

tactile.title: PHYSICAL GESTURES, DIFFERENTLY MAPPED.
tactile.desc: The same surface can behave in completely different ways — from precise cursor control and radial selection to shortcuts, sliders, and layered actions.

demos.m01Desc: Move the cursor freely, just like using a trackpad.
demos.m02Desc: Execute assigned commands or switch interaction modes with a press.
demos.m03Desc: Use rotational gestures to select options, execute actions, or adjust values.
demos.m04Desc: Run shortcuts directly and swipe to switch between pages of commands.

forceTouch.title: PRESSURE & HAPTIC FEEDBACK
forceTouch.subtitle: Traditional interfaces separate input and feedback. PitsBoard combines them into a single interaction loop.Touch to explore. Press to commit. Feel the result instantly through haptic feedback.A more direct connection between your hands and software.
forceTouch.placeholderText1: Traditional touch interfaces are limited to position.Force sensing adds depth to interaction.The same surface can become a button, a slider, a modifier, or a precision control depending on how pressure is applied.
forceTouch.placeholderText2: Visual interfaces rely on your eyes. Haptic feedback lets your hands understand what happened without looking away.Different actions, states, and confirmations can be communicated through touch, helping you stay focused on your work.

forceInputSteps.title: Find
forceInputSteps.desc: Your fingers land on the right place naturally.

forceInputSteps.title: Press (Force)
forceInputSteps.desc: Press down to commit your choice.

forceInputSteps.title: Action
forceInputSteps.desc: Command is executed. You stay in flow.

howItFeelsSteps.title: Find
howItFeelsSteps.desc: Contours guide your fingers to the right position.

howItFeelsSteps.title: Action
howItFeelsSteps.desc: Command is executed. You stay in flow.

basicHardware.title: HARDWARE
basicHardware.subtitle: Designed around touch, pressure, and muscle memory.
basicHardware.desc1: PitsBoard combines capacitive touch sensing,pressure detection, and customizable surface layoutsto create a more tactile way to interact with software.
basicHardware.desc2: Swap plates.Change layouts.Adapt the surface to your workflow.
basicHardware.baseChassisDesc: Solid bottom plate with anti-slip rubber grips

customPlates.title: CUSTOM PLATES
customPlates.subtitle: A physical interface you can reshape.
customPlates.desc1: PitsBoard uses interchangeable plates to turn the same sensing surface into different tactile layouts.
customPlates.desc2: Plates can be 3D printed with conductive touch features, letting you modify existing layouts or create entirely new ones for your own workflow.
customPlates.brassDesc: Flexible controls for design and creative tools.
customPlates.walnutDesc: Precision controls for navigation and modeling.
customPlates.acrylicDesc: Hands-on controls for mixing and music production.
customPlates.blueprintDesc: Precise CAD dimensional data (DXF / STEP) is available on GitHub. You can laser-cut acrylic or 3D-print your own custom plates.

overlay.title: CONTEXTUAL OVERLAY
overlay.subtitle: A contextual layer between your hands and software.
overlay.desc1: PitsBoard surfaces relevant actions, suggestions,and controls exactly when you need them.
overlay.desc2: Touch to reveal.Select to confirm.Then get out of the way.
overlay.list1: Ultra-lightweight HUD inspired by Apple & Raycast
overlay.list2: Toggle HUD visibility with [Shift + Caps] shortcut
overlay.list3: Automatic profile switching based on the active application

overlayExamples.title: OVERLAY EXAMPLES
overlayExamples.subtitle: Preset mappings for different applications. Profiles switch automatically based on the active window.

actionOverlay.title: ACTION OVERLAY
actionOverlay.subtitle: A temporary workspace for contextual information and actions.
actionOverlay.desc1: Display dynamic content from AI, APIs, and custom actions alongside your workflow.
actionOverlay.desc2: Show prompts, responses, progress, confirmations, and task-specific information when needed.

actionOverlayExamples.title: ACTION OVERLAY EXAMPLES
actionOverlayExamples.subtitle: Different overlays for different tasks, triggered by context and actions.

studio.title: PITSBOARD STUDIO
studio.subtitle: A browser-based platform for customizing and sharing PitsBoard profiles.Create your own shortcuts, layouts, and workflowswithout modifying the hardware.We're exploring a future where profiles can be shared,downloaded, and remixed by the community.

futureVision.title: FROM KIT TO PLATFORM
futureVision.subtitle: A roadmap from open experimentation to a refined product ecosystem.
futureVision.p1Desc: Build it your way. An open development kit for creating your own tactile interfaces — and exploring the ideas and interactions that will shape the future Pits Board product.
futureVision.p2Desc: Build it together. Share what you create, exchange ideas, and help shape what comes next. Feedback from early builders will directly inform Pits board Studio and the wider platform.
futureVision.p3Desc: efined for everyone. What we learn from the Builder Kit and community will shape a more polished product, backed by integrated hardware, scalable production, and dedicated support.

aboutDevelopment.title: ABOUT DEVELOPMENT
aboutDevelopment.subtitle: PitsBoard is an independent hardware project developed in Japan.
aboutDevelopment.desc1: PitsBoard is not a closed consumer device.
aboutDevelopment.desc2:
Rather than defining a finished product behind closed doors, we want to develop it in the open and shape it together with people around the world. 

We plan to share hardware designs, firmware, software tools, and specifications for swappable plates as development progresses.Users will be able to create their own plates and profiles, experiment with new interactions, and share what they build with the community.　

PitsBoard is still evolving. Feedback, experiments, and contributions from the community will help shape what it becomes.
aboutDevelopment.ctaDesc: Share feedback, swap modular hardware designs, and coordinate custom software mappings inside our Discord. Follow us on X for logs and developer updates.
